narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction has won 3 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $638M, and obligations are up 571.1% year over year. Thalle Construction received nearly all FY2026 obligations from the Department of Defense, which obligated $1.9B. Thalle Construction’s FY2026 work is concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has $1.9B in obligations, while Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $114K. Thalle Construction’s recent fiscal history shows variable annual obligations: FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, FY25 $285M, and FY26 $1.9B. Thalle Construction’s FY2026 totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the largest current-year obligations are tied to defense construction and civil engineering markets. This profile highlights a sudden, large increase in federal work for Thalle Construction concentrated in a single agency and primary NAICS market.

sections.heading: What is the size and trend of Thalle Construction's federal business?
sections.body: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal obligations in FY2026 to date and has 3 awards this fiscal year. Thalle Construction’s obligations are up 571.1% year over year. Thalle Construction’s recent annual obligations were FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, and FY25 $285M, showing a large jump in FY26.

sections.heading: Who buys from Thalle Construction and what markets does the company serve?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the top buyer for Thalle Construction and obligated $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior also awarded Thalle Construction $114K. Thalle Construction’s primary market is Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with $1.9B, and Thalle Construction also has work in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction totaling $114K.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys from Thalle Construction and obligated $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior also buys from Thalle Construction and awarded $114K.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy and civil engineering construction services to the government, concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with $1.9B in obligations. Thalle Construction also sells work in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction, with $114K in obligations.

Thalle Construction’s largest current-year obligations are reflected in the FY2026 to date totals, including $1.9B in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction and $114K in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction.
